sources.name: Directorate of Food & Civil Supplies, Gujarat
Directorate of Food & Civil Supplies, Gujarat - Ration Card Services
Form No. 2 - Gujarat Ration Card Application

fees.value: AAY & Priority Household/BPL: Free of cost (New ration card / New ration card by division), Rs. 5 (Duplicate). APL-1: Rs. 20 (New ration card / New ration card by division), Rs. 30 (Duplicate). APL-2: Rs. 20 (New ration card), Rs. 40 (New ration card by division / Duplicate). Form-2: Free of cost.
fees.evidence_quote: Form price: Free of cost ... Antyodaya Anna Yojna: New ration card: Free of cost, New ration card by division: Free of cost, Duplicate ration card: Rs. 5 ... Priority Household / BPL: New ration card: Free of cost, New ration card by division: Free of cost, Duplicate ration card: Rs. 5 ... APL-1: New ration card: Rs. 20, New ration card by division: Rs. 20, Duplicate ration card: Rs. 30 ... APL-2: New ration card: Rs. 20, New ration card by division: Rs. 40, Duplicate ration card: Rs. 40

online_available.evidence_quote: Public user can apply for these services online. All these application are available on comman service portal i.e. Digital Gujarat portal.

offline_available.evidence_quote: Families can apply through e-Gram center, Taluka Jan Seva Kendra, Zonal Office

required_documents.condition: Mandatory for all members above 20 years
required_documents.evidence_quote: ૧. ચૂંટણી ઓળખકાર્ડની ઝેરોક્ષ. ૨૦ વષડથી ઉિરના બધા સભ્યોએ ચૂંટણી ઓળખકાર્ડ આિવું ફરજીયાત છે.

required_documents.document_name: Assessment Register / Property Tax Receipt / Property Card
required_documents.evidence_quote: ૩. માલિકીના કિસ્સામાં આકારણીપત્રક/મિલકત વેરાની પહોંચ/ પ્રોપર્ટી કાર્ડની નકલ રજૂ કરવી

required_documents.document_name: Rent Agreement, Owner's Consent and Proof of Property
required_documents.evidence_quote: ૪. ભાડાના કિસ્સામાં ભાડા કરાર, મકાન માલિકની સંમતિ તથા મિલકતનો પુરાવો રજૂ કરવો.
૫. ઝૂંપડપટ્ટીનાં કિસ્સામાં આધારકાર્ડ કે ચૂંટણીકાર્ડની નકલ રજૂ કરવી
નોંધ: તમામ પુરાવાની સ્વયં પ્રમાણીત ઝેરોક્ષ નકલ આપવાની ફરજીયાત છે પરંતુ કોઇ એફીડેવીટ કરવાની રહેશે નહિ.

process_steps.description: Submit the application through e-Gram center, Taluka Jan Seva Kendra, Zonal Office, Digital Gujarat Portal, or Digital SevaSetu Portal using Form-2.
process_steps.evidence_quote: Families can apply through e-Gram center, Taluka Jan Seva Kendra, Zonal Office, Digital Gujarat Portal, or Digital SevaSetu Portal. ... Form: Form-2

process_steps.description: Family members have to complete e-KYC.
process_steps.evidence_quote: Family members have to complete e-KYC.

process_steps.description: Taluka Mamlatdar/Zonal Officer verifies the application.
process_steps.evidence_quote: Taluka Mamlatdar/Zonal Officer verifies the application.

process_steps.description: Spot visit may be conducted where necessary.
process_steps.evidence_quote: Spot visit may be conducted where necessary.
